info.title: Go Mode Service Discovery API Reference
info.description: Service-neutral JSON discovery manifest served publicly at `/.well-known/gomode.json` for Go Mode Android bootstrap. Clients must only accept `apiVersion` values they explicitly support and must require `webShell.bridgeVersion` to match the native bridge they implement.

get.description: Returns Go Mode service compatibility settings.

ClientExtensions.description:
ClientExtensions holds the settings objects of the Go Mode client capability
extensions, keyed as in ClientCapabilities.extensions. Clients encode it to
build that map, so generated SDKs carry each extension identifier.

com.fghbuild.gomode/display.description: Display is present while glasses are connected.

ConversationContext.description:
ConversationContext orders one advertised model-context resource for one
authenticated conversation. URI identifies the resource this update replaces.
Only a read of that URI can establish
a new epoch. Dependencies are private event routing, never model content.
Content is the server-defined public resource text after a tool; resource reads
omit it because their standard contents already carry the same text.

ConversationResultMeta.description: ConversationResultMeta carries an authorized resource update after a tool.

Display.description:
Display describes one connected display so a server can fit its content to
it. It is the settings object of the com.fghbuild.gomode/display client
capability extension, whose contract the Go constant DisplayExtension
documents. Servers must ignore fields they do not know.

bitsPerPixel.description:
BitsPerPixel is the pixel depth, from 1 to 24: a pixel shows one of
2^BitsPerPixel luminance levels or colours, as ColorSpace defines.

colorSpace.description: ColorSpace is what a pixel value represents.

height.description: Height is the number of pixel rows. It is positive.

imageTypes.description:
ImageTypes lists the MIME types of the glasses image blocks the client
draws on this display, such as "image/png". It is empty when the client
draws glasses text alone, as on Even Realities G2 with stock firmware.

shape.description: Shape is the visible area within the Width by Height pixels.

width.description: Width is the number of pixel columns. It is positive.

DisplayColorSpace.description:
DisplayColorSpace is what a display's pixel values represent.

- `luminance`: DisplayColorSpaceLuminance pixels are brightness levels that the device shows in its single tint, such as green on Even Realities G2.
- `rgb`: DisplayColorSpaceRGB pixels are colours. Below 24 bits per pixel, the client picks the 2^BitsPerPixel colours of each image from 24-bit RGB.

DisplayShape.description:
DisplayShape is the visible area of a display.

- `circle`: DisplayShapeCircle shows the circle inscribed in the Width by Height pixels; pixels outside it are not visible.
- `rectangle`: DisplayShapeRectangle shows every pixel.

ErrorBody.description: ErrorBody describes a Go Mode API error.

ErrorResponse.description: ErrorResponse is the standard JSON error envelope for Go Mode SDK clients.

LocationActivation.description: LocationActivation groups one location-based activation signal for a skill.

LocationWiFi.description: LocationWiFi matches any one of the configured Wi-Fi SSIDs.

ssids.description: SSIDs are Wi-Fi network names that can activate the skill.

PhysicalPosition.description: PhysicalPosition matches a named latitude and longitude within RadiusMeters.

name.description: Name is a user-facing label for this physical position.

radiusMeters.description: RadiusMeters is the activation radius around the latitude and longitude.

ResourceDependency.description:
ResourceDependency routes host change-feed events without interpreting domain
content. Each group contains at most 50 URIs. Empty aspects match any change.

Settings.description: Settings is the service compatibility document consumed by Go Mode clients.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion is the Go Mode discovery schema version. A client must reject
manifests with an API version it does not explicitly support.

serviceVersion.description:
ServiceVersion is the host product version. It is informational and does
not participate in Go Mode compatibility checks.

SkillActivation.description:
SkillActivation carries hints the shell matches against current context to
decide when to load a skill. Matching is on-device: the service never receives
the user's context or location just because a skill was considered.

locations.description:
Locations are local physical-location and Wi-Fi hints that make this skill
an activation candidate.

SkillFrontmatter.description:
SkillFrontmatter is the YAML frontmatter schema for a Go Mode SKILL.md file.

The Markdown body carries human and model instructions. The frontmatter carries
machine-readable activation hints and the MCP tool allowlist that the native
shell can register when the skill becomes active.

SkillGoMode.description: SkillGoMode contains Go Mode-specific SKILL.md frontmatter fields.

SkillMCPServer.description: SkillMCPServer declares which tools from an MCP endpoint belong to one skill.

protocolVersion.description: ProtocolVersion is the MCP protocol version spoken by this endpoint.

tools.description: Tools is the explicit allowlist of MCP tool names activated by the skill.

ToolGroup.description:
ToolGroup describes a bootstrap MCP tool group advertised by the manifest.

A tool group is the compatibility manifest's compact view of a Go Mode skill.
The authoritative context, activation hints, and tool subset live in the
skill's SKILL.md frontmatter; the manifest stays small so clients can decide
whether native features are compatible before loading skill files.

protocolVersion.description:
ProtocolVersion is the MCP protocol version spoken by this group endpoint.
The shell sends it on MCP requests so each group can be checked and
upgraded independently during protocol migrations.

skillUrl.description:
SkillURL points to the SKILL.md file whose frontmatter defines activation,
instructions, and the MCP tool subset for this skill.

VoiceGatewaySettings.description: VoiceGatewaySettings describes the preferred voice gateway for this service.

WebShellSettings.description: WebShellSettings describes the hosted frontend's native-shell contract.

bridgeVersion.description:
BridgeVersion is the hosted-frontend/native bridge contract version. A
shell must reject manifests whose bridge version differs from the bridge
version implemented by that shell.
